CONSENT
1.1 The Company shall not collect or process any personal data unless it has first obtained the
explicit, freely given, and informed consent of the Data Subject for each distinct purpose

Where data is classified as health data, the Company must obtain a separate, affirmative
opt-in consent that is recorded and time-stamped at the moment it is given.

All personal data must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher, and encrypted at rest
using AES-256 or an equivalent industry-standard algorithm.

Personal data belonging to residents of the European Economic Area must be stored and pro-
cessed exclusively within the European Economic Area, unless an approved transfer mechanism
is in

Where the Company uses automated or AI-driven systems to make decisions that materially
affect a Data Subject, it must provide a clear explanation of the logic involved and offer a route to
human review.

In the event of a personal data breach, the Company shall notify the relevant supervisory
authority without undue delay and in any case within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware
of the breach.
